attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent spine.** Columns 0 to 20, `sthA` to `metF`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and only 0 to 3% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 89 to 99.6% of these genes, fewest at column 2, `argH`, where it is also most hesitant at 0.50 bits.

**A single variable column follows at 21**, a hypothetical protein in 63% of chromosomes, named in 88% of calls. Then columns 22 to 47, `metL` to `fieF`, form another persistent spine, 95 to 99% carried, with 1 to 14% of calls in a region of plasticity. The model names 75 to 99% there, hesitating most at column 26, `rpmE`, 0.60 bits.

**The last third opens up.** Columns 48 to 79 are fork and variable columns, and 6 to 73% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 65 to 96% of genes, fewest at column 55, and hesitates most at column 79, `yihU`, 0.64 bits. A branch of 8 families runs through columns 48 to 55, carried by 11 to 13% of chromosomes, and another of 9 families through columns 64 to 72, carried by 10 to 11%.

**The `rha` and `frv` genes sit in the middle of this stretch**, [[rhamnose and fructose transport and catabolism]], with `rhaT` to `rhaM` at columns 54 to 60 and `frvA` to `frvR` at 61 to 64. The model reads them well, naming each in 83 to 84% of chromosomes. A third branch of 3 families runs through columns 75 to 77, carried by 13 to 14% of chromosomes.

**Across the whole window the model names 94% of genes** at 0.25 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.85 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 80% against 96%. The 7 columns most in regions of plasticity are named in 88% of calls; the other 73 in 95%.

label: sthA
facts:
WINDOW: the sthA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor sthA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,160 to 4,239 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying sthA once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.25 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,315 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 7,373 calls, named 81%, 0.71 bits; cloud 512 calls, named 23%, 2.54 bits. Outside an RGP 37,203 calls, named 96%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 5,997 calls, named 80%, 0.85 bits. Columns: 47 spine, 22 fork, 11 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.85 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 96%); 5,997 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 79 (yihU) 0.64 bits, RGP 73%; column 26 (rpmE) 0.60 bits, RGP 12%; column 57 (rhaB) 0.54 bits, RGP 16%. The 7 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.50 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 95%, 0.23 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 48-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 6-73%; the least: columns 0-20 (spine), RGP 0-3%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-20 (21 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-3%. Genes: sthA, oxyR, argH, argB "acetylglutamate kinase", argC, argE, ppc, eptC, yijO "AraC family transcriptional regulat…", frwD, pflC, pflD "pyruvate formate lyase family prote…", frwB "PTS fructose-like transporter subun…", frwC, ptsP, fsa, gldA, yijF "DUF1287 domain-containing protein", yijE, katG, metF. named 89-99.6% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 2 (argH), named 89%, 0.50 bits.
2. column 21 variable: RGP 2%. named 88%; 0.49 bits.
   21: "hypothetical protein" S 63%
3. columns 22-47 (26 columns) spine: share 95-99%, all P, RGP 1-14%. Genes: metL, metB "PLP-dependent transferase", metJ, yiiX "YiiX family permuted papain-like en…", rpmE, priA, cytR, ftsN, hslV, hslU "HslU--HslV peptidase ATPase subunit", menA, rraA, zapB, glpF, glpK "FGGY family carbohydrate kinase", glpX, fpr, uspD, yiiS "DUF406 domain-containing protein", yiiR "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yiiQ "YiiQ family protein", tpiA, cdh, sbp, pfkA, fieF. named 75-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 26 (rpmE), named 75%, 0.60 bits.
4. columns 48-79 (32 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 6-73%. named 65-96% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 55, named 65%; most hesitant at column 79, 0.64 bits.
   a second branch of 8 families through columns 48-55, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-13%, all S; the branch's families: ogrK, "contractile injection system protein, V…", "phage tail protein", "phage tail tape measure protein", "GpE family phage tail protein", "phage tail assembly protein", "phage major tail tube protein", "phage tail sheath protein"
   a second branch of 9 families through columns 64-72, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, all S; the branch's families: "phage virion morphogenesis protein", "phage tail protein", lysC, lysB, "DNZ54_00345 family protein", "glycoside hydrolase family 24 protein", "phage holin family protein", "tail protein X", "head completion/stabilization protein"
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 75-77, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-14%, all S; the branch's families: nadS, "hypothetical protein", "alpha/beta hydrolase"
